grammar.title: Inevitably with 必然
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 必然 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 必然 (bìrán) means "inevitably, necessarily" — it shows a result that's bound to happen given the situation, with no real alternative. It's formal and common in writing.

sentences.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò bìrán huì yǒu wèntí.
sentences.en: Doing it this way will inevitably cause problems.

sentences.zh: 努力学习必然会有好结果。
sentences.pinyin: Nǔlì xuéxí bìrán huì yǒu hǎo jiéguǒ.
sentences.en: Studying hard will inevitably bring good results.
